title: Microsoft Purview: network DLP for server and VM traffic through Azure Firewall
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the documented Azure Firewall preview from the roadmap's wider plans and gives the preview licensing and enforcement requirements correctly. The Purview control path should continue into the rule's action setting; this is a minor omission, not a publication blocker.

claims.claim: The Purview portal path runs through Data loss prevention, Policies, + Create policy, Inline web traffic, Custom, Custom policy, + Add cloud apps and Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers.
claims.quote: select Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy. ... Select Inline web traffic > Custom > Custom policy ... Select + Add cloud apps ... Enable the Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers enforcement location.
claims.fix: Keep the documented route, but continue controls[0].ui.path to the action control: 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Inline web traffic > Custom > Custom policy > + Add cloud apps > Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > + Create rule > Actions > Restrict browser and network activities > activity > Audit or Block'. The current route stops before the rule action that the row also governs; the continuation is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/firewall/configure-network-dlp.

claims.claim: In an Azure portal firewall policy the DLP Mode route is Settings > Security Profile Groups (preview) > Create security profile group > Basics > Data loss prevention (preview) > Configure protections > Mode.
claims.quote: Open the firewall policy in the Azure portal. ... Settings > Security Profile Groups (preview) > Create security profile group. ... On the Basics tab ... select Data loss prevention (preview). ... On the Configure protections tab ... For Mode

claims.claim: In the Azure portal firewall policy, Rules > Application rules > rule > security profile group associates the group with the target application rule.
claims.quote: Select Rules > Application rules and edit the target rule. ... Select the security profile group that contains the DLP profile.

claims.quote: Searched: Locations, Network, Inline, Browser in the fetched New-DlpCompliancePolicy reference. EnforcementPlanes lists Network, but the Locations examples use Microsoft 365 Copilot; no example or dedicated parameter names this network location.
